# Live Darshan Portal

> Free 24/7 live streaming platform for Hindu temple darshan and devotional content. Watch live video feeds of sacred temples from anywhere in the world.

## About

Live Darshan Portal is a web application that provides live YouTube stream embeds from Hindu temples across India. The site supports three languages: English, Hindi (हिंदी), and Gujarati (ગુજરાતી). All content is free and ad-free.

## Pages

### [12 Jyotirlingas Live Darshan](https://livedarshan.ambikainfotech.online/jyotirlingas)

Live darshan streams from 5 of the 12 sacred Jyotirlinga temples of Lord Shiva:

- **Somnath Temple** — Prabhas Patan, Gujarat
- **Mahakaleshwar Temple** — Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh
- **Omkareshwar Temple** — Khandwa, Madhya Pradesh
- **Kashi Vishwanath Temple** — Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh
- **Nageshwar Jyotirlinga** — Dwarka, Gujarat

### [Gujarat Temple Live Darshan](https://livedarshan.ambikainfotech.online/local-temples)

Live darshan streams from popular Gujarat temples:

- **Umiya Mata Temple** — Unjha, Gujarat
- **Ambaji Temple** — Ambaji, Gujarat
- **Salangpur Hanuman Temple** (Kashtabhanjan Hanumanji) — Salangpur, Gujarat
- **Dwarkadhish Temple** — Dwarka, Gujarat
- **Ranchhodrai Temple** — Dakor, Gujarat
- **Khodiyar Mandir** — Rajpara, Gujarat

### [Devotional Videos](https://livedarshan.ambikainfotech.online/devotional)

Curated devotional videos filterable by deity:

- **Lord Hanuman**: Hanuman Chalisa, Bajrang Baan, Sankat Mochan Hanuman Ashtak, Hanuman Aarti
- **Lord Shiva**: Shiv Tandav Stotram, Mahamrityunjaya Mantra, Om Namah Shivaya, Shiv Aarti
- **Goddess Durga**: Durga Chalisa, Kali Chalisa, Lalita Sahasranama, Devi Kavach
- **Lord Ganesh**: Ganesh Chalisa, Ganesh Aarti, Vakratunda Mahakaya Mantra, Ganpati Atharvashirsha
- **Lord Vishnu / Ram / Krishna**: Vishnu Sahasranama, Ram Raksha Stotra, Hare Krishna Mahamantra, Shri Ram Aarti
- **Lord Shani**: Shani Chalisa, Shani Aarti, Shani Beej Mantra, Shani Mahamantra

## Technical

- Built with Angular 21 (standalone components, lazy-loaded routes)
- Multilingual: English, Hindi, Gujarati
- All video content is embedded from YouTube
- No user data collected; no login required
